--- /dev/null
+++ b/usercase-test-coderl/test_solution_activities.py
@@ -0,0 +1,425 @@
+
+
+import autograd.numpy as anp
+import numpy as np
+import pytest
+
+def _load_burnman():
+    global burnman, Solution, FunctionSolution, IdealSolution, MechanicalSolution, PolynomialSolution, SubregularSolution, SymmetricRegularSolution, HGP_2018_ds633, SLB_2011, al_post_perovskite, fe_post_perovskite, mg_post_perovskite
+    import burnman
+    from burnman import Solution
+    from burnman.classes.solutionmodel import FunctionSolution
+    from burnman.classes.solutionmodel import IdealSolution
+    from burnman.classes.solutionmodel import MechanicalSolution
+    from burnman.classes.solutionmodel import PolynomialSolution
+    from burnman.classes.solutionmodel import SubregularSolution
+    from burnman.classes.solutionmodel import SymmetricRegularSolution
+    from burnman.minerals import HGP_2018_ds633
+    from burnman.minerals import SLB_2011
+    from burnman.minerals.SLB_2011 import al_post_perovskite
+    from burnman.minerals.SLB_2011 import fe_post_perovskite
+    from burnman.minerals.SLB_2011 import mg_post_perovskite
+
+
+P_LOW = 1.0e5
+P_HIGH = 1.0e9
+T = 1000.0
+
+
+def _binary_olivine_endmembers(formula_a="[Mg]2SiO4", formula_b="[Fe]2SiO4"):
+    return [
+        [SLB_2011.forsterite(), formula_a],
+        [SLB_2011.fayalite(), formula_b],
+    ]
+
+
+def _regular_opx_model():
+    return SymmetricRegularSolution(
+        endmembers=[
+            [SLB_2011.forsterite(), "[Mg][Mg]Si2O6"],
+            [SLB_2011.forsterite(), "[Mg1/2Al1/2][Mg1/2Al1/2]AlSiO6"],
+        ],
+        energy_interaction=[[burnman.constants.gas_constant * 1.0e3]],
+    )
+
+
+def _subregular_model():
+    return SubregularSolution(
+        endmembers=[
+            [SLB_2011.forsterite(), "[Mg]3[Al]2Si3O12"],
+            [SLB_2011.forsterite(), "[Fe]3[Al]2Si3O12"],
+            [SLB_2011.forsterite(), "[Mg]3[Mg1/2Si1/2]2Si3O12"],
+        ],
+        energy_interaction=[
+            [[10.0e3, -10.0e3], [5.0e3, 3.0e3]],
+            [[-10.0e3, -10.0e3]],
+        ],
+        entropy_interaction=[[[1.0, -2.0], [0.0, 1.0]], [[0.0, 0.0]]],
+        energy_ternary_terms=[[0, 1, 2, 3.0e3]],
+        volume_ternary_terms=[[0, 1, 2, 3.0e-5]],
+    )
+
+
+def _polynomial_model():
+    model = PolynomialSolution(
+        endmembers=[
+            [SLB_2011.forsterite(), "[Mg]3[Al]2Si3O12"],
+            [SLB_2011.forsterite(), "[Fe]3[Al]2Si3O12"],
+            [SLB_2011.forsterite(), "[Mg]3[Mg1/2Si1/2]2Si3O12"],
+        ],
+        ESV_interactions=[
+            [10.0e3, 1.0, 0.0, 0, 1, 1, 2],
+            [-10.0e3, -2.0, 0.0, 0, 2, 1, 1],
+            [5.0e3, 0.0, 0.0, 0, 1, 2, 2],
+            [3.0e3, 1.0, 0.0, 0, 2, 2, 1],
+            [-10.0e3, 0.0, 0.0, 1, 1, 2, 2],
+            [-10.0e3, 0.0, 0.0, 1, 2, 2, 1],
+            [5.0e3, 0.5, 0.0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 2, 1],
+            [-5.0e3, -1.0, 0.0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 2, 1],
+            [2.5e3, 0.0, 0.0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 2, 1],
+            [1.5e3, 0.5, 0.0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 2, 1],
+            [-5.0e3, 0.0, 0.0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 2, 1],
+            [-5.0e3, 0.0, 0.0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 2, 1],
+            [3.0e3, 0.0, 3.0e-5, 0, 1, 1, 1, 2, 1],
+        ],
+    )
+    model.set_composition(np.array([0.2, 0.3, 0.5]))
+    model.set_state(P_LOW, T)
+    return model
+
+
+def _excess_gibbs_function_ppv(pressure, temperature, molar_amounts):
+    n_moles = anp.sum(molar_amounts)
+    molar_fractions = molar_amounts / n_moles
+    return n_moles * 60.0e3 * molar_fractions[0] * molar_fractions[2]
+
+
+def _function_model():
+    return FunctionSolution(
+        endmembers=[
+            [mg_post_perovskite(), "[Mg][Si]O3"],
+            [fe_post_perovskite(), "[Fe][Si]O3"],
+            [al_post_perovskite(), "[Al][Al]O3"],
+        ],
+        excess_gibbs_function=_excess_gibbs_function_ppv,
+    )
+
+
+def assert_array(actual, expected):
+    np.testing.assert_allclose(np.asarray(actual, dtype=float), np.array(expected))
+
+
+def _ideal_olivine_activities(molar_fractions):
+    return np.asarray(molar_fractions, dtype=float) ** 2
+
+
+def _ideal_counterpart(model):
+    return IdealSolution(model.endmembers)
+
+
+def _expected_nonideal_activity_coefficients(model, pressure, temperature, molar_fractions):
+    ideal_model = _ideal_counterpart(model)
+    nonconfigurational_gibbs = np.asarray(
+        model.excess_partial_gibbs_energies(pressure, temperature, molar_fractions)
+    ) - np.asarray(
+        ideal_model.excess_partial_gibbs_energies(pressure, temperature, molar_fractions)
+    )
+    return np.exp(nonconfigurational_gibbs / (burnman.constants.gas_constant * temperature))
+
+
+def assert_nonideal_activity_formula(model, pressure, temperature, molar_fractions):
+    ideal_model = _ideal_counterpart(model)
+    expected_coefficients = _expected_nonideal_activity_coefficients(
+        model, pressure, temperature, molar_fractions
+    )
+
+    assert_array(
+        model.activity_coefficients(pressure, temperature, molar_fractions),
+        expected_coefficients,
+    )
+
+    assert_array(
+        model.activities(pressure, temperature, molar_fractions),
+        ideal_model.activities(pressure, temperature, molar_fractions)
+        * expected_coefficients,
+    )
+
+
+def test_mechanical_model_returns_unit_activities_for_pure_endmember():
+
+
+
+
+
+    _load_burnman()
+    model = MechanicalSolution(_binary_olivine_endmembers())
+    molar_fractions = np.array([1.0, 0.0])
+
+    assert_array(
+        model.activity_coefficients(P_HIGH, T, molar_fractions),
+        [1.0, 1.0],
+    )
+    assert_array(model.activities(P_HIGH, T, molar_fractions), [1.0, 1.0])
+
+
+def test_solution_ideal_olivine_activities_follow_composition_session_state():
+
+
+
+
+
+
+    _load_burnman()
+    solution = Solution(
+        name="ideal olivine activity probe",
+        solution_model=IdealSolution(_binary_olivine_endmembers()),
+    )
+
+    solution.set_composition(np.array([0.5, 0.5]))
+    solution.set_state(P_LOW, T)
+    assert solution.pressure == 100000.0
+    assert solution.temperature == 1000.0
+    assert_array(solution.molar_fractions, [0.5, 0.5])
+    assert_array(solution.activities, [0.25, 0.25])
+    assert_array(solution.activity_coefficients, [1.0, 1.0])
+
+    solution.set_composition(np.array([0.25, 0.75]))
+    solution.set_state(P_LOW, T)
+    assert_array(solution.molar_fractions, [0.25, 0.75])
+
+    assert_array(solution.activities, _ideal_olivine_activities(solution.molar_fractions))
+    assert_array(solution.activity_coefficients, [1.0, 1.0])
+
+
+def test_solution_nonideal_coefficients_use_current_pressure_temperature_and_composition():
+
+
+
+
+
+    _load_burnman()
+    solution = Solution(name="regular opx activity probe", solution_model=_regular_opx_model())
+
+    solution.set_composition(np.array([0.5, 0.5]))
+    solution.set_state(P_LOW, 1000.0)
+    expected_coefficients = _expected_nonideal_activity_coefficients(
+        solution.solution_model,
+        solution.pressure,
+        solution.temperature,
+        solution.molar_fractions,
+    )
+    ideal_model = _ideal_counterpart(solution.solution_model)
+
+    assert_array(
+        solution.activity_coefficients,
+        expected_coefficients,
+    )
+
+    assert_array(
+        solution.activities,
+        ideal_model.activities(
+            solution.pressure, solution.temperature, solution.molar_fractions
+        )
+        * expected_coefficients,
+    )
+
+    solution.set_state(P_LOW, 2000.0)
+    assert solution.temperature == 2000.0
+    expected_coefficients = _expected_nonideal_activity_coefficients(
+        solution.solution_model,
+        solution.pressure,
+        solution.temperature,
+        solution.molar_fractions,
+    )
+
+    assert_array(
+        solution.activity_coefficients,
+        expected_coefficients,
+    )
+
+    assert_array(
+        solution.activities,
+        ideal_model.activities(
+            solution.pressure, solution.temperature, solution.molar_fractions
+        )
+        * expected_coefficients,
+    )
+
+
+def test_temkin_ideal_solution_activities_match_entropy_literal_relation():
+
+
+
+
+
+    _load_burnman()
+    solution = Solution(
+        name="ol-q-water melt (HGP 2018)",
+        solution_model=IdealSolution(
+            endmembers=[
+                [HGP_2018_ds633.foL(), "[Mg]4[Sitet]1[Vac]2"],
+                [HGP_2018_ds633.faL(), "[Fe]4[Sitet]1[Vac]2"],
+                [HGP_2018_ds633.qL(), "[]0[Sinet]1[Vac]2"],
+                [HGP_2018_ds633.h2oL(), "[]0[]0[H]2"],
+            ]
+        ),
+    )
+
+    solution.set_composition(np.array([0.2, 0.3, 0.1, 0.4]))
+    solution.set_state(P_LOW, T)
+    expected_activities = np.exp(
+        -solution.excess_partial_entropies / burnman.constants.gas_constant
+    )
+
+    assert_array(solution.activities, expected_activities)
+    assert_array(
+        solution.activities,
+        np.exp(-solution.excess_partial_entropies / burnman.constants.gas_constant),
+    )
+    assert_array(solution.activity_coefficients, [1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0])
+
+
+def test_regular_model_activity_methods_include_nonideal_coefficients():
+
+
+
+
+
+    _load_burnman()
+    model = _regular_opx_model()
+    molar_fractions = np.array([0.0, 1.0])
+    expected_coefficients = np.array([np.exp(1.0), 1.0])
+
+    assert_array(model.activity_coefficients(P_LOW, T, molar_fractions), expected_coefficients)
+
+    assert_array(
+        model.activities(P_LOW, T, molar_fractions),
+        _ideal_counterpart(model).activities(P_LOW, T, molar_fractions)
+        * expected_coefficients,
+    )
+
+
+def test_subregular_function_and_polynomial_activity_methods():
+
+
+
+
+
+
+    _load_burnman()
+    molar_fractions = np.array([0.2, 0.3, 0.5])
+
+    subregular = _subregular_model()
+    assert_nonideal_activity_formula(subregular, P_LOW, T, molar_fractions)
+
+    function = _function_model()
+    assert_nonideal_activity_formula(function, P_LOW, T, molar_fractions)
+
+    polynomial = _polynomial_model()
+    assert_nonideal_activity_formula(polynomial, P_LOW, T, molar_fractions)
+
+
+def test_solution_activity_properties_are_available_after_state_is_set():
+
+
+
+
+    _load_burnman()
+    solution = Solution(
+        name="fresh ideal olivine activity probe",
+        solution_model=IdealSolution(_binary_olivine_endmembers()),
+    )
+    solution.set_composition(np.array([0.5, 0.5]))
+    solution.set_state(P_LOW, T)
+
+
+    assert_array(solution.activities, [0.25, 0.25])
+    assert_array(solution.activity_coefficients, [1.0, 1.0])
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "model,molar_fractions",
+    [
+        (_regular_opx_model, np.array([0.0, 1.0])),
+        (_subregular_model, np.array([0.2, 0.3, 0.5])),
+        (_polynomial_model, np.array([0.2, 0.3, 0.5])),
+        (_function_model, np.array([0.2, 0.3, 0.5])),
+    ],
+)
+def test_nonideal_activity_coefficients_reject_zero_temperature_boundary(model, molar_fractions):
+
+
+
+
+
+    _load_burnman()
+    model = model()
+    with pytest.raises(Exception) as excinfo:
+        model.activity_coefficients(P_LOW, 1.0e-10, molar_fractions)
+
+    assert type(excinfo.value) is Exception
+    assert str(excinfo.value) == "Activity coefficients not defined at 0 K."
+
+
+def test_two_solution_instances_keep_independent_cached_activity_state():
+
+
+
+
+
+    _load_burnman()
+    a = Solution(name="a", solution_model=IdealSolution(_binary_olivine_endmembers()))
+    b = Solution(name="b", solution_model=IdealSolution(_binary_olivine_endmembers()))
+
+    a.set_composition(np.array([0.5, 0.5]))
+    a.set_state(P_LOW, T)
+    b.set_composition(np.array([0.25, 0.75]))
+    b.set_state(P_LOW, T)
+    assert_array(a.activities, [0.25, 0.25])
+
+    assert_array(b.activities, _ideal_olivine_activities(b.molar_fractions))
+
+    a.set_composition(np.array([0.75, 0.25]))
+    a.set_state(P_LOW, T)
+
+    assert_array(a.activities, _ideal_olivine_activities(a.molar_fractions))
+    assert_array(b.activities, _ideal_olivine_activities(b.molar_fractions))
+
+
+def test_solution_recomposition_uses_current_activity_session():
+
+
+
+
+
+    _load_burnman()
+    solution = Solution(name="reset probe", solution_model=IdealSolution(_binary_olivine_endmembers()))
+    solution.set_composition(np.array([0.5, 0.5]))
+    solution.set_state(P_LOW, T)
+    assert_array(solution.activities, [0.25, 0.25])
+    assert_array(solution.activity_coefficients, [1.0, 1.0])
+
+    solution.set_composition(np.array([0.25, 0.75]))
+    solution.set_state(P_LOW, T)
+
+    assert_array(solution.activities, _ideal_olivine_activities(solution.molar_fractions))
+    assert_array(solution.activity_coefficients, [1.0, 1.0])
+
+
+def test_repeated_solution_activity_sessions_return_unitless_arrays():
+
+
+
+
+    _load_burnman()
+    for _ in range(10):
+        solution = Solution(
+            name="loop activity probe",
+            solution_model=IdealSolution(_binary_olivine_endmembers()),
+        )
+        solution.set_composition(np.array([0.5, 0.5]))
+        solution.set_state(P_LOW, T)
+
+        assert np.asarray(solution.activities).shape == (2,)
+        assert_array(solution.activities, [0.25, 0.25])
+        assert_array(solution.activity_coefficients, [1.0, 1.0])

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+
+
+
+
+export NODE_OPTIONS="${NODE_OPTIONS:-} --max-old-space-size=4096"
+export MAVEN_OPTS="${MAVEN_OPTS:-} -Xmx3g -XX:+UseG1GC"
+export GRADLE_OPTS="${GRADLE_OPTS:-} -Xmx3g -XX:+UseG1GC"
+export TEST_JVM_OPTS="${TEST_JVM_OPTS:-} -Xmx3g"
+set -e
+cd /workspace/repo
+set -euo pipefail
+
+cd /workspace/repo
+
+
+
+export PIP_NO_INDEX=1
+export PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1
+export PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1
+unset PYTEST_ADDOPTS
+unset PYTEST_PLUGINS
+export PYTHONPATH="/workspace/repo${PYTHONPATH:+:${PYTHONPATH}}"
+
+exec python -m pytest /workspace/repo/usercase-test-coderl/test_solution_activities.py -v

rationale: The retained nop solution.py and solutionmodel.py Git blobs equal the recovered reference patch preimages b370f439 and e08ec127. That patch implements the missing _ideal_activities_fct and requested activity APIs. Eager package imports and four parametrized constructors currently fail during collection. Defer only those operations into every original test body; preserve all assertions, values, model factories and parameter combinations. Do not install any reference code.
